'''Wojciech Wisniewski'''<ref name="dt-19475">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19475 anti-WYS Raltiir ops - No R3], DeckTech (Wojciech "Hipo" Wisniewski, 24 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19475/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19475/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (also listed as '''Wojtek Wisniewski'''; DeckTech handle '''Hipo''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]] list on DeckTech in October 2001. Wisniewski finished 9th at the [[2015 European Championship]]<ref name="pc-euc2015">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-european-championships/ 2015 European Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> and 17th at the [[2016 European Championship]].<ref name="pc-euc2016">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-european-championships/ 2016 European Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
